experiments.scope: The 39-step compression of sha256-r39-prefix-v1 as used by the construction (proof.md Sections 2 and 10). Trial 0 runs the shipped program's Attack.claw on the published Table 23 pair (chaining value CV_PUB, a0 = A[4], u = W1) with the folded kernel built for CV_PUB: the filters W9 in F9, W8 in F8 and W17 = published value, then both second blocks are built, compressed from CV_PUB for 39 steps and compared. Trials 1 to 255 draw a chaining value, an even a0 and an odd u from the trial seed, recover a1, build the first message and its partner from the construction, and compare the 39-step trajectories of both with the published pair. No message pair is returned: the pair is a collision of the compression function from CV_PUB, not from the standard IV, so the organizer's digest check on blocks hashed from the IV is not a collision, and a full collision of the target is not claimed.
experiments.hypothesis: Observations (the program's own, untrusted). Trial 0: claw_returned_pair 1, passed_f9 1, passed_f8 1, passed_w17 1, pair_is_published 1, sfs_collision 1, published_w16_is_g 1, published_w17 1, kernel_records 962, claw_ops 6174. Trials 1 to 255: transplant_ok 1 (the states A[6..19] and E[10..19] of both messages equal the published ones), w1_is_u 1, w16_identity 1 (W16 - g = F(u) - F(a0) mod 2^32) on all 255. Returned pairs: 0 of 256. Not shown: any claw search at full size, the tail, any cost.

experiments.scope: Trial 0 runs one window of the shipped program (folded 256-lane kernel, every parameter of class P unchanged: DP = low 7 bits zero, table 26,112 words, queue 4096, stage 2 as in proof.md Section 3) on a first block drawn from the trial seed, cut to 2^22 walk evaluations (16,384 iterations of 256 lanes) instead of 2^26, in check mode: every raw claw is asserted to satisfy F(a0) = F(u), a0 even, u odd and W16 = g by the construction (build and expand). Trials 1 to 255 return nothing. No message pair is returned. The generator is charged at its halt cap 575,000 operators because the sandbox has no WebAssembly runtime.
experiments.hypothesis: Observations (the program's own, untrusted), trial 0: iterations 16384, dp_hits 32865, matches 1705, stage2_iterations 2892, raw_claws 836, opposite_parity 836, distinct_claws 807, passed_f9 11, passed_f8 0, passed_w17 0, kernel_records 926, ops 28241656 (generator 582408 of them). No assertion fails. The window is 1/16 of the program's window, so its operations per claw are not the ledger value of proof.md Section 5. Returned pairs: 0 of 256.
